purpose: Empirical validation of the revised v3 semantic instrument of the independently pinned Sol boredom adjudicator against a fresh frozen 55-case held-out corpus. v4 is an instrument revision after the v3 run failed the determinate-specificity gate 29/39 = 0.744 and the reference-agreement gate 44/54 = 0.815, with all ten misses one-directional: the judge read effort withdrawal into pace wishes and productive uptake into compliance reports, readings the v2 prompt itself licensed. The v3 instrument narrows the two definitions to the registered senses: effort withdrawal now requires a public stop of work (a pace or skip wish is process impatience, and an explicit continue commitment defeats withdrawal), and productive uptake now requires a forward-looking inquiry move (a compliance report, an instruction restatement, or a bare answer is not uptake). Derivation rules, output schema shape, all five gates, and every governance rule are unchanged. The corpus is fresh (spent v1, v2, and v3 corpora permanently excluded) and every reference label was confirmed by a blind second reader (claude-sonnet-5); disagreements were dropped, never relabeled. This request authorizes nothing by itself; it never authorizes the 36-dialogue confirmation, any live study, or any learner repair, rerun, replacement, or outcome selection.

stoppingRules.caseProcessing: frozen corpus order; each case ends with one final completed adjudication or bounded-technical-ceiling exhaustion
stoppingRules.completedOutputsFinal: any resolved model call is a final measurement outcome, including malformed, low-confidence, and indeterminate outputs
stoppingRules.technicalRecovery: only a thrown transport error consumes an extra reservation, never output content
stoppingRules.ceilingExhaustion: a case exhausting its reservations without a completed call ends the validation as a categorical technical failure; no gate can pass
stoppingRules.gateEvaluation: all five gates are computed once, after every case is final; no interim analysis and no mid-run change to request, prompt, wrapper, corpus, or schema
stoppingRules.failureDisposition: any gate failure is a categorical instrument result; the confirmation stays on HOLD, nothing is retried or re-scored, and any further iteration needs a fresh corpus, a written diagnosis, and separate explicit human approval

confirmationRequest.status: remains HOLD_PENDING_EXPLICIT_HUMAN_APPROVAL; this validation neither launches nor advances it

payload.scope: Frozen public held-out corpus utterances only.
